description: Defines which data fields the BattleArena combat GUI must display. Placement and exact phrasing are left to the GUI implementation — only field presence and correctness matter. Set 'enabled' to false on any screen or field to suppress it from the console output.

characterCard.description: Character status block shown throughout combat for each combatant. All cards MUST be the same height regardless of class or alive/dead status — non-spellcasters render a dimmed placeholder MP row and an empty spell row so all cards remain aligned.

requiredFields.description: Character display name
Character level (1–20). Displayed as 'Lvl N  ClassName' beneath the name line in the card.
Character class name fetched from DB (e.g. Barbarian, Mage). Rendered as text next to Level.
Character sex stored in DB as single char flag: M = Male, F = Female, X = None. Displayed in full in the card: 'Female  ·  Lvl 5  Mage  ·  Human'
Character race name (e.g. Human, Orc, Elf). Rendered in the card after class: 'Female  ·  Lvl 5  Mage  ·  Human'
Current hit points (can be negative after KO)
Maximum hit points — must be > 0
Current mana points — shown for ALL characters. Non-casters render a dimmed '-- / --' placeholder so card height stays uniform.
Maximum mana points. Spellcasters only (MaxMana > 0). Formula: Mage=50+(INT-10)*10+level*5, Priest/Druid/Bard=40+(INT-10)*8+level*5
Mana regenerated each tick. Derived from Intelligence, level, equipped gear bonuses and regenerative spells. Formula: max(1, (INT-10)/2 + level/2 + gearBonus)
Turn meter value (0–100), tracked via TurnMeterGain / TurnEnd events
Weapon currently held in the right hand — always shown regardless of spellcaster status
Active attack source used this turn (weapon or spell name), updated on TurnStart events
List of spells the character has memorized. Each entry has: Name, School, DamageCount, DamageDie, DamageType, ManaCost, SpellLevel. Only present when Character.MemorizedSpells.Count > 0.

Compact single-row spell summary rendered inside the character card, below the HP bar. Format: 'SP  <SpellA>  <SpellB>  …' (spell names truncated to ~7 chars, separated by two spaces). Non-spellcasters render this row as blank space so card height stays equal. Colour: label in DarkYellow, names in Yellow.
Alive/dead flag derivable from CurrentHitPoints

startupSheets.description: Pre-combat stat sheets shown before the first action. Each combatant gets a full-character summary card.

requiredFields.description: Character display name
Character race name. Must be shown on the stat sheet on the main header row alongside sex, level, and class.
Character sex (M/F/X)
Character level
Character class
Maximum hit points
Base turn speed
Strike rating
Base attributes (STR, DEX, INT) with ability modifiers
Equipped armor name, AC, mitigation percentage
Weapon (name, damage dice, attack bonus) or memorized spells list
Attack power breakdown (StrikeRating + Level + ability mod + source bonus)
Defense power breakdown (AC + dexterity cap)

roundBar.description: A full-width progress bar shown at the TOP of the combat screen, immediately below the BattleArena header and above the character grid. Renders every tick. A round is a fixed number of ticks (RoundLength = 10). The bar fills left-to-right from empty to full as ticks advance within the round and resets at each RoundStart. Console rendering: 'ROUND N  [████░░░░░░░]  tickInRound / 10 ticks' using Unicode block characters (█ = U+2588 filled, ░ = U+2591 light shade). Fill colour: Blue. Empty colour: DarkBlue. Label colour: Cyan.

requiredFields.description: Current round number, starting at 1. Updated on RoundStart and RoundEnd events.
Absolute tick counter. Position within round = ((Tick - 1) % RoundLength) + 1, range 1–10.
Fixed at 10. One round = 10 ticks. RoundStart fires at tick 1, 11, 21 … RoundEnd fires at tick 10, 20, 30 …
0.0–1.0 fill fraction for the round bar. At tick 5 of 10 this is 0.5. Formula: ((Tick-1) % 10 + 1) / 10.0

attackEvent.description: Displayed each time a character makes an attack (CombatLogEntry with EventType = Attack)

requiredFields.description: Name of the attacking character
Name of the defending character
Weapon or spell used for the attack
d20 roll result
Attacker's total combat power
Defender's total defense power
Whether the attack connected
Critical hit flag
Fumble flag
Damage dealt — required to be > 0 on a hit, null/absent on a miss

manaEvent.description: Tracks mana changes during combat. Two event types: ManaDeduct (spell cast) and ManaRegen (end-of-round regeneration). Only relevant for spellcasters (MaxMana > 0).

requiredFields.description: Spellcaster whose mana changed
Mana spent on this cast (ManaDeduct event). Null on ManaRegen events.
Mana pool after the change. Use this to update the MP bar.
Amount regenerated this tick (ManaRegen event). Derived from Character.ManaRegenPerTick.

damageEvent.description: Displayed when a character takes HP damage (CombatLogEntry with EventType = Damage)

requiredFields.description: Name of the character taking damage
HP lost in this event
HP before taking damage
HP after taking damage
Unique GUID identifying this combat run
Total ticks the combat lasted
Winning party name
Losing party name
Dead (HP ≤ -10) or KnockedOut (HP 0 to -9)

hitLabels.description: Graded hit severity labels shown in attack events. Label is computed by CombatHitLabelService.GetLabel(damage, targetMaxHp) as damage / targetMaxHp percentage.
